title: Jar Shanty
style: A sea-shanty-flavored instrumental (concertina, fiddle, bodhran) in miniature, sounding slightly 'tiny' and boxy when we are inside the jar; storm strings and timpani; a calm lullaby; a deep mysterious low-brass chord for the final pullback.
key: D minor -> D major -> ambiguous low brass
rules: Original instrumental only. No vocals, no lyrics, no spoken word.

hit_points.cue: Filtered timpani roll from inside the jar.
Shanty in the storm - fiddle and bodhran, urgent.
Harp glissando, the storm strings fade.
The shanty returns as a calm, happy lullaby.
The lullaby stops; one deep low-brass note.
Deep mysterious low-brass chord swells with a soft tam-tam, held to the cut.

end_card.cue: Music resolves on the final chord exactly at the cut; ODDLY sting plays over 2.0s end card.
